answer: Every agent posts a bond and keeps a public hash chain, one signed link per epoch committing to the last hash and its attestation work. Miss the window, an eighth of the bond burns. Each chain is the unforgeable history of one identity; a clone pays the full bond again per fake plus upkeep every epoch. At 200 POA a fake, fifty fakes cost 10,000 POA upfront and keep bleeding, while a fake nets a few POA per epoch. Picture a wharf ledger where every hull checks in each tide or gets towed; the chain is onyx, one break and the hull goes dark, while the honest meadow keeps growing.
